description: This file defines the ThingAssert class, a custom assertion utility for testing objects of type Thing in a Java project. It provides a fluent API for asserting various properties and characteristics of Thing instances, including identifiers, namespace, policies, ACLs, attributes, features, lifecycle, revisions, timestamps, metadata, and JSON equality. The class extends an abstract base assertion class and implements several interfaces to facilitate JSON comparison and predicate-based assertions.

classes.name: ThingAssert
classes.description: A final class providing custom assertions for Thing objects, enabling detailed and fluent verification of various properties of a Thing such as ID, namespace, ACL, attributes, features, lifecycle, revision, timestamps, metadata, and JSON equality.

methods.name: hasId
methods.description: Asserts that the actual Thing has the specified ID.

methods.name: hasNoId
methods.description: Asserts that the actual Thing has no ID.

methods.name: hasNamespace
methods.description: Asserts that the actual Thing has the specified namespace.

methods.name: hasNoNamespace
methods.description: Asserts that the actual Thing has no namespace.

methods.name: hasPolicyId
methods.description: Asserts that the actual Thing has the specified policy ID (overloaded for String and PolicyId).

methods.name: hasNoPolicyId
methods.description: Asserts that the actual Thing has no policy ID.

methods.name: hasAcl
methods.description: Asserts that the actual Thing's ACL matches the expected ACL.

methods.name: hasNoAcl
methods.description: Asserts that the actual Thing has no ACL.

methods.name: hasAclEntry
methods.description: Asserts that the ACL contains an entry for the given authorization subject with specific permissions.

methods.name: hasAclEntry
methods.description: Asserts that the ACL contains a specific ACL entry.

methods.name: hasAttributes
methods.description: Asserts that the Thing has the specified attributes.

methods.name: hasNoAttributes
methods.description: Asserts that the Thing has no attributes.

methods.name: hasAttribute
methods.description: Asserts that the attribute at the given JSON pointer matches the expected value.

methods.name: hasNotAttribute
methods.description: Asserts that the attribute at the given JSON pointer does not exist.

methods.name: hasDefinition
methods.description: Asserts that the Thing's definition matches the expected definition.

methods.name: hasDefinition
methods.description: Asserts that the Thing's definition string matches the expected string.

methods.name: hasNoDefinition
methods.description: Asserts that the Thing has no definition.

methods.name: hasFeature
methods.description: Asserts that the Thing has the specified feature.

methods.name: hasFeatureWithId
methods.description: Asserts that the Thing has a feature with the specified ID.

methods.name: hasNotFeatureWithId
methods.description: Asserts that the Thing does not have a feature with the specified ID.

methods.name: hasFeatures
methods.description: Asserts that the Thing has the specified set of features.

methods.name: hasNoFeatures
methods.description: Asserts that the Thing has no features.

methods.name: hasFeatureProperties
methods.description: Asserts that a specific feature has the expected properties.

methods.name: featureHasNoProperties
methods.description: Asserts that a feature has no properties.

methods.name: hasFeatureProperty
methods.description: Asserts that a feature's property at the given path has the expected value.

methods.name: hasNotFeatureProperty
methods.description: Asserts that a feature does not have a property at the specified path.

methods.name: hasLifecycle
methods.description: Asserts that the Thing has the specified lifecycle.

methods.name: hasNoLifecycle
methods.description: Asserts that the Thing has no lifecycle.

methods.name: hasRevision
methods.description: Asserts that the Thing has the specified revision.

methods.name: hasNoRevision
methods.description: Asserts that the Thing has no revision.

methods.name: hasModified
methods.description: Asserts that the Thing's modified timestamp matches the expected timestamp.

methods.name: isModified
methods.description: Asserts that the Thing has been modified.

methods.name: hasNoModified
methods.description: Asserts that the Thing has not been modified.

methods.name: isCreated
methods.description: Asserts that the Thing has a creation timestamp.

methods.name: hasCreated
methods.description: Asserts that the Thing's creation timestamp matches the expected timestamp.

methods.name: hasNoCreated
methods.description: Asserts that the Thing has no creation timestamp.

methods.name: isModifiedAfter
methods.description: Asserts that the modified timestamp is after the specified Instant.

methods.name: isNotModifiedAfter
methods.description: Asserts that the modified timestamp is before the specified Instant.

methods.name: isEqualToButModified
methods.description: Asserts that actual Thing matches expected, ignoring modifications.

methods.name: hasMetadata
methods.description: Asserts that the Thing's metadata matches the expected metadata.

methods.name: hasEqualJson
methods.description: Checks for JSON equality of the actual and expected Thing objects using a field selector and predicate.

methods.name: hasEqualJson
methods.description: Checks for JSON equality of the actual and expected Thing objects using a predicate.
